All 23 assigned items are authored and registered on the original A/B pages. Step 3 receipts record **5 accept, 6 repaired, and 12 escalate**; the pair’s scope receipt is current and sufficient. No new supplier item or page was added.

Final proof-layout passed for **23 items and 104 steps**, with zero defects. Precheck, rendering, content policy, strict contracts, dependency levels, and focused dependency checks passed. Batch-scoped `validate-plan` passed with eight redundant-prerequisite warnings. Run-aware validation still has Step 4 page-closure findings and a page cycle; the owned pair has no remaining B-page dependency. The coverage checklist retains its documented low-yield warning.

The main open mathematical obligations are in [item 10](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-analytic-quasiconformality-implies-modulus-distortion.md), [item 12](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-circular-dilatation-quasisymmetry-and-analytic-quasiconformality.md), and [item 13](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-inverse-of-a-quasiconformal-map-is-quasiconformal.md). The item 12 statement now includes the orientation condition; the source issues remain escalated.
